name: mandate
title: Mandate
description: A CV site for an interim or turnaround executive, set like the tombstone announcements of the financial pages: every assignment a 2pt ruled box of centred serif capitals, two across, in black ink on salmon newsprint.

tokens.--font-serif: the transitional serif of the announcements: names, organizations, roles, headings and page text
tokens.--font-sans: the small grotesque for everything around them: the menu, summaries, highlights, dates and places, contact lines, the footer
tokens.--font-mono: the fixed-width typeface for code in page text
tokens.--text-xs: smallest text: the menu, small capital labels, the footer
tokens.--text-s: small text: summaries and highlights inside a box, period and place, contact lines, skills
tokens.--text-l: the organization and role in a box, the name in the masthead and profile, opening sentences
tokens.--text-xl: headings inside a page, and the organization and role on a role's own page
tokens.--text-xxl: page headlines, and the role on its own page when it has no organization
tokens.--leading-body: space between lines of running text
tokens.--leading-tight: space between lines of a heading
tokens.--tracking-wide: letter spacing of the wide capitals: organizations, names, small labels
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the menu, the small-capital dates and places, the Print button
tokens.--color-bg: the salmon newsprint: the background of every page (charcoal at night)
tokens.--color-text: the black ink: all text, headings and the Print button (salmon ink at night)
tokens.--color-muted: lighter ink: highlights in a box, the record note, the footer, dates on notes, the print note
tokens.--color-accent: links and focus rings, in the same ink as the text
tokens.--color-rule: the 2pt box rules, the short rules inside a box, the masthead and section rules, the current menu item
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-mark: highlight colour when text is selected
tokens.--rule-box: weight of the tombstone box and the heavy rules
tokens.--rule-thin: weight of the short rules inside a box and the light dividers
tokens.--measure: longest comfortable line of page text
tokens.--lead-width: width of the headline column beside the announcements on the home page
tokens.--cv-width: width of the CV, a role's page and other pages
tokens.--space-3: normal gap between the lines of a box
tokens.--space-4: gap between boxes, and the side padding inside a box
tokens.--space-5: gap above page content and the top padding of a box
tokens.--space-6: largest gap: below the content and beside the home headline column
